name: week
title: Tour operations week
subtitle: Read-only report. Fictional demo until your records are imported.

sections.title: Departures
sections.sql: select code,name,travel_date,pax,awaiting_confirmation,currency,margin_cents from tours.booking_margins where status='confirmed' and travel_date between current_date and current_date+30 order by travel_date

sections.title: Release dates
sections.sql: select code,product,service_date,release_on,units,allocated,unsold from tours.release_queue where status='held' order by release_on

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from tours.record_checks order by rule,record
